name: Fish Food
source:
You just moved into Cala Marine, a touristy beachtown. Trying to have the waves wash away the dreaded monotony of city life. Though every scenic town has its own hidden secrets that should be kept sunken below the surface. With our newfound hope, how long can we last with every twist and turn? 

Will you sink further into the depths that you’ve grown familiar with?

Or will the newfound companion that you meet help you swim in more manageable waters?

[From [url=https://jesterwonderpop.itch.io/fish-food]itch.io[/url]]
